programme.title: ADCC - Denver Opens
programme.desc: The Opens make their way to the mile high city where the best martial arts from the US look to stake their claim for supremacy as the circuit heats up. In this heart-pounding instalment, we bring you all the action from the epic showdown held in the magnificent city of Denver. Former UFC Strawweight Champion of the World Rose Namajunas known for her exceptional martial arts abilities, Rose is now ready to put her skills to the ultimate test in the realm of grappling. Witness her transition from the cage to the mats, as she grapples her way through some of the most intense matches of her career. ADCC Opens superstar and prodigy 16-year-old phenom, Helena Craver, steps onto the mats to showcase her unparalleled talent. With her sights set on glory, she aims to conquer the teenage, adults, and absolute divisions a feat that has never been done before. In a clash of titans, long time elite grappler Ryan Aitkens, a formidable competitor in his own right, is set to go head-to-head against the multiple-time world champion, Mateus Lutes. ADCC - Denver Opens
programme.desc: The Opens make their way to the mile high city where the best martial arts from the US look to stake their claim for supremacy as the circuit heats up. In this heart-pounding instalment, we bring you all the action from the epic showdown held in the magnificent city of Denver. Former UFC Strawweight Champion of the World Rose Namajunas known for her exceptional martial arts abilities, Rose is now ready to put her skills to the ultimate test in the realm of grappling. Witness her transition from the cage to the mats, as she grapples her way through some of the most intense matches of her career. ADCC Opens superstar and prodigy 16-year-old phenom, Helena Craver, steps onto the mats to showcase her unparalleled talent. With her sights set on glory, she aims to conquer the teenage, adults, and absolute divisions a feat that has never been done before. In a clash of titans, long time elite grappler Ryan Aitkens, a formidable competitor in his own right, is set to go head-to-head against the multiple-time world champion, Mateus Lutes. Brace yourself for an explosive battle between these two grappling juggernauts, as they leave everything on the mats in pursuit of victory.

programme.title: The Big Fight
programme.desc: During WWII the Japanese occupied most of China and used the people for forced labor. They were notoriously cruel and some Chinese rose in resistance.

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: This is the story of the bodybuilder, Martial Artist and actor who wrote his own destiny and walked his own path. A legendary tale that's never been told on-screen before.

programme.title: City Ninja
programme.desc: A tournament fighter becomes involved in the search for a valuable pendant.

programme.title: The Four Shaolin Challengers
programme.desc: Lin Che Jong, a former student of Wong Fei Hung, is a hawker in a small town. Whe he stands up to gangsters from the local crime family, his fellow hawkers and business folk encourage and help him to open a Kung Fu school in town.

programme.title: The Guy with the Secret Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.title: Hands Of Death
programme.desc: Chow, on a visit to Thailand meets a girl who takes him around to see the sites. What he's really interested in is Thai boxing, so she brings him to a match where her friend is competing.

programme.title: Image of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung.

programme.title: The Black Dragon's Revenge
programme.desc: Three rival gangs embark on a search for Bruce Lee's handwritten "finger fighting " manual.

programme.title: Death Machines
programme.desc: An evil Oriental Dragon Lady injects three martial arts fighters with a serum that turns them into zombie-like assassins, and she sends them out against her enemies.

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Kill Point
programme.desc: An L.A. cop investigating the rape and murder of his wife traces the crime to a psycho biker gang that smuggles guns. He teams up with an FBI agent to stop them and catch his wife's killers.

programme.title: Nine Death of the Ninja
programme.desc: A young martial artist-in-training named Tiger (Lou) is being stalked by Evil Ninja.

programme.title: The Black Draguon
programme.desc: Decent, simple, honest Chinese farmhand and ace martial artist Tai-Lin travels to the Philippines seeking his fortune. He gets a job as a dock worker and then discovers that his employers are involved in a crime syndicate that smuggles opium.

programme.title: The Doll Squad
programme.desc: Squad of beautiful government agents tries to catch saboteurs.

programme.title: The Big Fight
programme.desc: During WWII the Japanese occupied most of China and used the people for forced labor. They were notoriously cruel and some Chinese rose in resistance.

programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.title: Hands Of Death
programme.desc: Chow, on a visit to Thailand meets a girl who takes him around to see the sites. What he's really interested in is Thai boxing, so she brings him to a match where her friend is competing.

programme.title: Image of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung.

programme.title: El Desertor
programme.desc: Luego de ser reclutado para el servicio militar y ante los abusos de su jefe inmediato, el Subteniente Montilla, Julián escapa del cuartel, lo que provoca una feroz persecución por parte de Montilla, quien se ha enamorado de Sagrario y hará todo lo posible para separar a los jóvenes.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Secuestro
programme.desc: Un joven con talento en la música sueña con ser un gran artista hasta que conoce al hijo de un poderoso narcotraficante colombiano quién promete ayudarlo a cambio de que trabaje para ellos. El joven no se imagina en que mundo se está metiendo. La fama le costará lo que más ama.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Baile Peligroso
programme.desc: Miluska es una cantante, que se gana la vida haciendo shows musicales para un hotel turístico en el sur de Perú. Durante las presentaciones conoce una variedad de empresarios de todo nivel, entre ellos está Don Mauro, un señor respetable, que admira mucho a Miluska, Carlos Reyes, un traficante de mujeres que se hace pasar por empresario. Al ser cliente frecuente del hotel se gana cierta confianza con las chicas, un día le ofrece a Miluska hacer un show para su hotel en otra provincia, pero no sabían que caerían en una trampa difícil de escapar.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: El Mariachi Gringo
programme.desc: Comedia romántica sobre un joven de la América profunda que -tras tener como improvisado maestro de guitarra a un emigrante- viaja a México huyendo de su vida tediosa y de su familia, para ejercitarse como mariachi.

programme.title: Canon: Fidelidad al Límite
programme.desc: Mariana de 35 años, es una arquitecta que trabaja y es socia de un importante despacho de arquitectos, está casada con Julián de 40 años, quien es corresponsal de guerra. Está enamorados, felices, con relación sexual cotidiana. Son padre de dos hijos de 14 y 17 año. En el juego sexual, Julián menciona que no le importaría la infidelidad a condición de estar enterado del hecho con detalles.

programme.title: Bendita Calamidad
programme.desc: Los hermanos Fayos, Anselmo y Ricardo, están con el agua al cuello. Su bar no funciona, el Ayuntamiento lo clausura y se ha agotado el dinero que, para ir tirando, solicitaron a unos prestamistas que no se andan con contemplaciones a la hora de cobrar. Piden consejo a un abogado poco amigo de la ley, Antonio Orestes, que les sugiere una vía rápida para acabar con sus problemas: El secuestro exprés de un constructor de Tarazona.

programme.title: Aerosol
programme.desc: El líder de una banda mexicana mata a un oponente en la guerra de pandillas en los 80's, por lo que huye a la ciudad de Los Ángeles, California. Dieciocho años después regresa al barrio sin un objetivo definido, sólo para encontrar a su hermano menor, involucrado en las pandillas de hoy. El crimen organizado utiliza niños para distribuir droga en los barrios. En combatir la corrupción y el crimen que hay en el barrio, Nuk encuentra un significado para su retorno y un camino para redimir las muertes que causó

programme.title: Fantasías
programme.desc: La historia de Brenda y Antonio, una pareja de clase media con dos hijos adolescentes y una vida sexual aburrida, en busca de nuevas experiencias, primero con su sexy sirvienta. Más tarde, siguiendo el consejo de Esther, una amiga mayor que tiene un estilo de vida swinger junto con su esposo, deciden explorar la posibilidad de despertar una nueva pasión al ligar con Miguel y Claudia, una pareja swinger. Pero luego llegan los problemas.

programme.title: Death Of A Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, un cazador de fantasmas, Carter Simms, recibe un pago para llevar a cabo una investigación paranormal de una supuesta casa encantada. Junto con un cámara, un reportero y un defensor espiritual, se embarca en un viaje de tres noches hacia el terror.

programme.title: Día 13
programme.desc: Colton está enamorado de su nueva vecina Heather, pero teme que su padre adoptivo sea parte de un culto satánico. Él trata de protegerla y descubre que la verdad es más horrible.

programme.title: Dinastia Vivanco Movie
programme.desc: Devolver al vino lo que el vino nos a dado: Directed by Zev Robinson. Pedro Vivanco started off delivering his family's wine door-to-door ...

programme.title: El Demonio del Sueño [Conjuring the Beyond]
programme.desc: Un estudio del sueño se torna oscuro cuando los participantes comienzan a desaparecer. ¿Acaso es todo parte de su imaginación o hay algo demoníaco detrás del asunto?

programme.title: Eva + Candela
programme.desc: La ambición profesional de dos mujeres fuertes e independientes las une, pero también es lo que finalmente las separa, mientras somos testigos de cómo su intenso amor se metamorfosea en medio de etapas de enamoramiento, sensualidad, amor, comodidad y, finalmente, rutina.

programme.title: El Coro
programme.desc: El célebre y exigente director de uno de los mejores coros infantiles del mundo descubre un extraordinario talento en un niño huérfano conflictivo. Sus estrictas pero inspiradoras lecciones despertarán en el joven el amor por la música.

programme.title: Exorcismo En El Vientre [Exorcism in Utero]
programme.desc: Una mujer embarazada debe encontrar la forma de salvarse a sí misma y a su bebé después de encontrar un poderoso anillo que la posee cuando se lo prueba.

programme.title: Fanny y Alexander
programme.desc: Suecia, principios del siglo XX. Fanny y Alexander son dos hermanos de ocho y diez años, respectivamente, que pertenecen a una familia dedicada al teatro. Al morir su padre, la madre se casa con un pastor protestante y el ambiente cálido y familiar del que disfrutaban cambia radicalmente. El pastor es un hombre severo, inflexible y posesivo que impone a todos una disciplina cruel.

programme.title: For Our Eyes Only Spanish
programme.desc: In anticipation of the 25th chapter in the iconic James Bond Saga, based on the novels of British writer Ian Fleming, Sabbatical Entertainment presents "For Our Eyes Only" an enthralling documentary that recounts and relives all of 007's menacing missions throughout this legendary cinematic franchise, from 1962's premiere of "Dr. No", to the highly anticipated "No Time To Die.

programme.title: Girl Gets Girl
programme.desc: Basada en la exitosa serie web española «Chica busca chica», Inés vive una vida encantadora con su bella novia. Todo su mundo se pone patas arriba cuando pierde un plazo de entrega por estar demasiado ocupada seduciendo a todas las mujeres atractivas con las que se cruza. Sin trabajo, sin dinero y sin novia, Inés se enfrenta a una existencia desconocida en un día de locura.

programme.title: Grey Eyes
programme.desc: En un futuro postapocalíptico, la humanidad es daltónica. Un brillante científico muere repentinamente, dejando su preciado maletín -lleno de una droga sintética altamente adictiva que permite a la gente volver a ver los colores- a Ana, una niña de 12 años. La posesión del maletín la convierte en el objetivo de un doctor con malvados planes para la droga, y su única esperanza de escapar de su persecución depende de la ayuda de los dos devotos guardaespaldas del científico muerto. Juntos, su épico y peligroso viaje gira en torno a un tremendo secreto: la propia Ana podría ser la clave para salvar un mundo en ruinas.

programme.title: I'm Ringo
programme.desc: El boxeador argentino Oscar Natalio Bonavena, conocido popularmente como Ringo, fue asesinado en la puerta de un burdel de Nevada, Reno, en Estados Unidos, en 1976. Ringo, que había peleado con Muhammad Ali, nunca había perdido la esperanza de tener la oportunidad de una revancha con el boxeador estadounidense.

programme.title: Influencer
programme.desc: Las redes sociales pueden ser un trampolín extraordinario hacia la fama y el éxito. Pero, ¿qué ocurre cuando a un influencer con 4 millones de seguidores le roban el móvil?

programme.title: Kruel
programme.desc: Kruel es un largometraje de terror/thriller sobre un asesino psicótico que se hace pasar por heladero para acercarse a los objetos de su afecto.

programme.title: La Granja del Horror [Pig Killer]
programme.desc: Basado en la aterradora historia real de Robert 'Willy' Pickton, el granjero de cerdos que se convirtió en un prolífico asesino en serie, cuyos horribles crímenes conmocionaron al mundo.

programme.title: Las Puertas del Infierno [Insidious Inferno]
programme.desc: Una cabaña aislada está plagada de una serie de horribles asesinatos, sin que los habitantes lo sepan, algo de otro mundo acecha dentro de los pasillos.

programme.title: Los Girasoles
programme.desc: Giovanna y Antonio, dos jóvenes napolitanos, se casan doce días antes del comienzo de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Unos años más tarde, Antonio es dado por desaparecido en el frente ruso pero su esposa se niega a olvidarle. Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Many Pieces of Something
programme.desc: En medio de la jungla sexual de un festival de música en España, un grupo de jóvenes intenta alcanzar sus sueños.

programme.title: Masacre En El Bosque [Pillow Party Massacre]
programme.desc: Perseguidos por una broma que terminó en una tragedia, cinco amigos se reúnen para sanar sus heridas. Pero no todos son capaces de olvidar, y está claro que alguien, o algo, está buscando vengarse.

programme.title: Niño Perdido [Lost Child]
programme.desc: Una veterana del ejército regresa a su hogar y se encuentra con un niño perdido en el bosque. Mientras trata de buscar la identidad del chico, ella descubre un mundo de folklore y mentiras.

programme.title: One in a Thousand
programme.desc: Iris ha sido expulsada del colegio y pasa los días con sus primos. Cuando conoce a Renata, queda fascinada, y pronto empiezan a flirtear a pesar de los crecientes rumores sobre el pasado de Renata.

programme.title: Prosthesis
programme.desc: Un artista de prótesis con un pasado traumático encuentra un cadáver en su laboratorio. Mientras decide qué hacer con el cuerpo, tendrá que hacer malabarismos con su extraña vida familiar, la posibilidad de un nuevo amor, crear la prótesis perfecta para un cliente muy especial, todo ello en medio del rodaje local de una película de zombis.

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: Un hombre de 50 años se queda sin medios para mantener su estilo de vida basado en el placer y trama un plan muy cuestionable para vender la casa histórica de su madre sin que ella lo sepa. Para que no se entere, construye una réplica del dormitorio de su madre y le dice que la casa está prohibida mientras se restaura para devolverle su antiguo esplendor. Sorprendentemente, es el inevitable fracaso de su cruel y escandalosa ilusión lo que podría darle la oportunidad de restaurar su propia humanidad.

programme.title: Sadomaster
programme.desc: La violencia urbana extrema reina en Argentina. El senador Beccar Varela se alza como la única forma de frenar la violencia con su política de «tolerancia cero». La gente no sospecha que Beccar es el jefe de la banda nazi que provoca la violencia. Cuando los miembros de la banda torturan y violan a un retrasado, un misterioso vengador enmascarado comienza su brutal venganza contra las bandas y los políticos corruptos.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng ha conocido a una chica española en Internet y ha decidido dejarlo todo y vivir su historia de amor en España. Las cosas no salen como él esperaba y acaba sin novia, sin dinero y sin pasaporte, por lo que tiene que buscarse la vida como inmigrante ilegal en un país del que no sabe nada. Su suerte cambiará cuando conozca a Marisa, una soñadora de sangre caliente que ha encontrado su lugar en este país; y a Mioara, una chica de Bucarest que llegó hace dos años buscando trabajo. Como suele ocurrir cuando somos jóvenes y las cosas suceden demasiado deprisa, sus corazones llevarán a estos desconocidos de los árboles por caminos no demasiado rectos.

programme.title: Maid
programme.desc: Cuando su señora contrata a otra sirvienta para que la ayude en las tareas domésticas, una criada amargada e introvertida causa estragos en la casa.

programme.title: Dirty Conscience
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes reclutas de la policía chilena son asignados a un duro y condecorado oficial para entrenarlos. Pronto queda claro que su nuevo jefe está implicado en graves casos de corrupción. Al principio, los dos jóvenes policías intentan hacer la vista gorda. Pero cuando su jefe empieza a dudar de su lealtad, los dos reclutas deben elegir entre salvar su honor y su carrera, antes de que su jefe los mate.

programme.title: Until You Untie Me
programme.desc: Una joven bailarina se sume en una desesperación emocional tras perder a su familia en un accidente mortal. Su camino de autodestrucción se enreda con un médico infame por mala praxis. Su encuentro desemboca en una febril historia de amor que explora el fetichismo, el sadomasoquismo y el bondage.

programme.title: Visiones Mortales [Scalper]
programme.desc: Todos a su alrededor, la psíquica Clementine Carter, están siendo brutalmente asesinados por un asesino enmascarado apodado "El Escalpador". ¿Es el psicópata muerto Andrew Lubitz vuelto de la tumba, un asesino imitador o un horror más allá de la imaginación? Clementine debe usar su segundo sentido para mantenerse un paso adelante de la cuchilla del maníaco y resolver el misterio.

programme.title: Wedding In New York
programme.desc: En España, la madre de Carlos le pide que les represente en una boda familiar en Nueva Jersey. Él acepta encantado la invitación, pero con un pícaro plan en mente: Convencerá a su buen amigo Gonzalo para que ocupe su lugar en la boda familiar y así poder visitar en secreto a su antiguo amor. Una serie de coincidencias se convertirán en grandes complicaciones cuando los dos amigos se encuentren enamorados de la futura novia y de la amante del novio.

programme.title: Fanny y Alexander
programme.desc: Suecia, principios del siglo XX. Fanny y Alexander son dos hermanos de ocho y diez años, respectivamente, que pertenecen a una familia dedicada al teatro. Al morir su padre, la madre se casa con un pastor protestante y el ambiente cálido y familiar del que disfrutaban cambia radicalmente. El pastor es un hombre severo, inflexible y posesivo que impone a todos una disciplina cruel.

programme.title: One in a Thousand
programme.desc: Iris ha sido expulsada del colegio y pasa los días con sus primos. Cuando conoce a Renata, queda fascinada, y pronto empiezan a flirtear a pesar de los crecientes rumores sobre el pasado de Renata.

programme.title: I'm Ringo
programme.desc: El boxeador argentino Oscar Natalio Bonavena, conocido popularmente como Ringo, fue asesinado en la puerta de un burdel de Nevada, Reno, en Estados Unidos, en 1976. Ringo, que había peleado con Muhammad Ali, nunca había perdido la esperanza de tener la oportunidad de una revancha con el boxeador estadounidense.

programme.title: Death Of A Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, un cazador de fantasmas, Carter Simms, recibe un pago para llevar a cabo una investigación paranormal de una supuesta casa encantada. Junto con un cámara, un reportero y un defensor espiritual, se embarca en un viaje de tres noches hacia el terror.

programme.title: Many Pieces of Something
programme.desc: En medio de la jungla sexual de un festival de música en España, un grupo de jóvenes intenta alcanzar sus sueños.

programme.title: El Coro
programme.desc: El célebre y exigente director de uno de los mejores coros infantiles del mundo descubre un extraordinario talento en un niño huérfano conflictivo. Sus estrictas pero inspiradoras lecciones despertarán en el joven el amor por la música.

programme.title: Niño Perdido [Lost Child]
programme.desc: Una veterana del ejército regresa a su hogar y se encuentra con un niño perdido en el bosque. Mientras trata de buscar la identidad del chico, ella descubre un mundo de folklore y mentiras.

programme.title: Dirty Conscience
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes reclutas de la policía chilena son asignados a un duro y condecorado oficial para entrenarlos. Pronto queda claro que su nuevo jefe está implicado en graves casos de corrupción. Al principio, los dos jóvenes policías intentan hacer la vista gorda. Pero cuando su jefe empieza a dudar de su lealtad, los dos reclutas deben elegir entre salvar su honor y su carrera, antes de que su jefe los mate.

programme.title: All the Fires
programme.desc: A pyromaniac teenager sets off on a journey in search of a girl he met online and to confront his sexuality, while leaving behind all his fires.

programme.title: A Haunting In Ravenwood
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados llega a la casa de la difunta esposa del esposo, donde se han mantenido flores en memoria de la mujer fallecida. Pronto, sucesos inquietantes llevan a la nueva esposa a creer que está perdiendo la razón.

programme.title: Restoration
programme.desc: Un hombre de 50 años se queda sin medios para mantener su estilo de vida basado en el placer y trama un plan muy cuestionable para vender la casa histórica de su madre sin que ella lo sepa. Para que no se entere, construye una réplica del dormitorio de su madre y le dice que la casa está prohibida mientras se restaura para devolverle su antiguo esplendor. Sorprendentemente, es el inevitable fracaso de su cruel y escandalosa ilusión lo que podría darle la oportunidad de restaurar su propia humanidad.

programme.title: Wedding In New York
programme.desc: En España, la madre de Carlos le pide que les represente en una boda familiar en Nueva Jersey. Él acepta encantado la invitación, pero con un pícaro plan en mente: Convencerá a su buen amigo Gonzalo para que ocupe su lugar en la boda familiar y así poder visitar en secreto a su antiguo amor. Una serie de coincidencias se convertirán en grandes complicaciones cuando los dos amigos se encuentren enamorados de la futura novia y de la amante del novio.

programme.title: El Demonio del Sueño [Conjuring the Beyond]
programme.desc: Un estudio del sueño se torna oscuro cuando los participantes comienzan a desaparecer. ¿Acaso es todo parte de su imaginación o hay algo demoníaco detrás del asunto?

programme.title: Prosthesis
programme.desc: Un artista de prótesis con un pasado traumático encuentra un cadáver en su laboratorio. Mientras decide qué hacer con el cuerpo, tendrá que hacer malabarismos con su extraña vida familiar, la posibilidad de un nuevo amor, crear la prótesis perfecta para un cliente muy especial, todo ello en medio del rodaje local de una película de zombis.

programme.title: Masacre En El Bosque [Pillow Party Massacre]
programme.desc: Perseguidos por una broma que terminó en una tragedia, cinco amigos se reúnen para sanar sus heridas. Pero no todos son capaces de olvidar, y está claro que alguien, o algo, está buscando vengarse.

programme.title: Accidental Blessing
programme.desc: Beatriz, una psicóloga fracasada, huye a la casa de su infancia para escapar de los cargos de fraude, sólo para descubrir que su extravagante tía ha convertido la finca en un instituto. Lo que al principio parece una terrible sorpresa, en realidad la ayudará a encontrar por fin un camino satisfactorio en la vida como profesora de teatro poco convencional.

programme.title: 50 Chuseok
programme.desc: La realización de un video por el medio siglo de la comunidad coreana en Argentina lleva al actor Chang Sung Kim de regreso a su tierra natal. Pero pronto el viaje deviene en un inesperado y transformador reencuentro con su familia y la cultura.

programme.title: Concrete Skies
programme.desc: Private detective, WILL MAHONEY, gets the worst news of his life: a diagnosis of stage IV lung cancer with only two months left to live. The bleak prognosis motivates Mahoney to try an untested experimental treatment. With nothing to lose, he vows to take down the drug runners who have eluded him for nine years. Dreary and constantly enshrouded in gray overcast, Syracuse, New York, makes for a highly profitable home base for Bobby and Donnie’s East Coast drug cartel for over a decade. Using connections of his ex-girlfriend, Jennifer, plus his “creative” problem solving skills (ESP), Mahoney infiltrates their inner circle and cripples their operation. Or so it was made to look. Blessed with a remission and a rekindling of his relationship with Jennifer, Mahoney enjoys a blissful vacation with her in Jamaica… only to return to a nightmare worse than terminal cancer! Fists, bullets and deceit fly under the cover of the CONCRETE SKIES!!

programme.desc: Tracer, a hit man with emotional issues, is on a job to collect from a client when it goes sour. Shaken by the experience, he vows to do one last job so that he can be the kind of father his young son has always craved. Katherine Macro, a beautiful independent newswoman, pays for a disc of the Mayor raping a female staffer. What she doesn’t know is the Mayor and Carlo; his security guard with a dangerously violent personality, have hired Tracer to kill her before she can run the story. She gets a call from her friend Gage Johnson; a former cop turned no nonsense hit man.

programme.title: Big City Knights

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: A Dream Called Death

programme.title: A Tiger in Winter

Roger expresses all the hatred how he murdered his brother Marcos. Max and Torrealba arrive and find Roger out of control, with Camila as hostage.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila approaches him trying to calm him down and the commando takes advantage of the situation to subdue the young man. Camila runs to take refuge in Max's arms. Later, they inform Ezequiel that Camila is safe. When the inspector interrogates her, she, following instructions, does not press charges and this infuriates Max, but it is part of his conciliatory plan.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Detective Torrealba presses Marcelina; Max tries to convince him that his mother is sick and not responsible for her actions. Camila is detained for questioning and replies that she does not wish to press charges against Marcelina and her only desire is to live in peace and be happy.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max comes to get Camila from the police, she thanks him for the gesture but refuses to reveal her plans to him. Mother Isabel finds the three women together and suspects them of planning to kill Camila. Beginning her plan, Camila convinces Max and Marcelina to put the past behind them.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila visits Marcelina. Before her and Max tells her that it was Rosa, her mother, who made her change her mind, and they will not press charges against her. Max asks her to marry him but she surprises him by telling him that she no longer loves him. Max proposes to Astrid a formal relationship to forget about Camila forever.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: As part of her plan, Camila has changed, both physically and in her attitude. This is how she presents herself to everyone. Max and Astrid continue their romance; however, he keeps remembering Camila and wants to know all the truths that Astrid and Marcelina are hiding.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Only Mother Isabel is convinced of the noble attitude of her girl who desisted from her intentions to collect the betrayal of the three women and even asked for their forgiveness. Ezequiel tells Camila about his son's engagement and she reproaches him for going so fast, forgetting the great love he said he had for her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto with double intentions invites Camila to dinner at his house so that she can get to know her new family. Ezequiel insists on talking to her about romance and feelings and the young woman reminds him that this is not what they agreed upon. Marcelina visits Ezequiel in the hospital and he takes the opportunity to threaten her if she tries to hurt Camila again.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is alert to the obvious hypocrisy of Fausto and Patricia, however, she manages to get out of the incessant questions by sticking to her strategy of bringing peace to the two families. programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc:
China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.
In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Why is the US suddenly stepping in to rescue the yen?
programme.desc: The US and Japan have joined forces to prop up the yen — but can intervention really reverse its slide? What's driving the yen's weakness? Why is Washington stepping in? And what can history tell us about the odds of a lasting turnaround?

programme.title: Zhejiang transforms technology into market success
programme.desc: East China's Zhejiang Province has long been known for its strong private-sector economy and vibrant business environment. Now, it's putting that market-driven approach to work in next-generation technology, helping turn lab innovations into real-world products. CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu reports from Zhejiang.

programme.title: The village workshops giving rural residents a new choice in Zhejiang
programme.desc: For millions of Chinese workers, earning more has often meant leaving home. But one village in Zhejiang is trying to change that. A local workshop is bringing jobs closer to home. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun sees how it is creating new opportunities.

programme.title: How China turns humble loofah plants into premium bath products
programme.desc: A simple loofah can become a premium bath or kitchen product worth more than $10. Behind that transformation is a partnership between Huangmei in Hubei and Ningbo — one provides the land and labor, the other the technology and markets. CGTN's Yu Bokun finds out how this humble crop goes global.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI. #SummerDavos2026

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.
We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.
One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc:
China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.
In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.
We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.
One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: Zhejiang transforms technology into market success
programme.desc: East China's Zhejiang Province has long been known for its strong private-sector economy and vibrant business environment. Now, it's putting that market-driven approach to work in next-generation technology, helping turn lab innovations into real-world products. CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu reports from Zhejiang.

programme.title: The village workshops giving rural residents a new choice in Zhejiang
programme.desc: For millions of Chinese workers, earning more has often meant leaving home. But one village in Zhejiang is trying to change that. A local workshop is bringing jobs closer to home. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun sees how it is creating new opportunities.

programme.title: How China turns humble loofah plants into premium bath products
programme.desc: A simple loofah can become a premium bath or kitchen product worth more than $10. Behind that transformation is a partnership between Huangmei in Hubei and Ningbo — one provides the land and labor, the other the technology and markets. CGTN's Yu Bokun finds out how this humble crop goes global.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI. #SummerDavos2026

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: Summer Davos 2026: The Future of Jobs, Skills, and Sustainable Growth
programme.desc:
Global trade is undergoing profound change as economies grapple with shifting supply chains, rapid advances in artificial intelligence, and the transition to cleaner energy.
We are coming to you from the Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, where policymakers, business leaders, and academics from around the world are discussing how to navigate these transformations.
One key question at this year's forum is how these changes will affect workers, and whether they will create new opportunities or deepen existing challenges. To discuss the future of jobs, skills, and sustainable growth, Song Ruixin is joined by Professor Mercedes Maroto-Valer, Deputy Principal for Global Sustainability at Heriot-Watt University, and Kathleen Alexander, co-founder and CEO of Savor, a San Jose based food startup.

programme.title: Zhejiang transforms technology into market success
programme.desc: East China's Zhejiang Province has long been known for its strong private-sector economy and vibrant business environment. Now, it's putting that market-driven approach to work in next-generation technology, helping turn lab innovations into real-world products. CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu reports from Zhejiang.

programme.title: The village workshops giving rural residents a new choice in Zhejiang
programme.desc: For millions of Chinese workers, earning more has often meant leaving home. But one village in Zhejiang is trying to change that. A local workshop is bringing jobs closer to home. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun sees how it is creating new opportunities.

programme.title: How China turns humble loofah plants into premium bath products
programme.desc: A simple loofah can become a premium bath or kitchen product worth more than $10. Behind that transformation is a partnership between Huangmei in Hubei and Ningbo — one provides the land and labor, the other the technology and markets. CGTN's Yu Bokun finds out how this humble crop goes global.

Dances with the Wind
programme.desc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

programme.title: Nothing Good Ever Happens
programme.desc: Neil who is a painter and graphic designer, on a morning just like any other morning his girlfriend Amanda leaves him and moves out of their house (don't worry, it's a rental.) That morning Neil tries to cope as best he knows how, but in a strange turn of events he ends up shooting back a glass of bleach. He wakes up to suicide watch and court appointed therapy as well as the empty void Amanda left. Now Neil has to decide what he can do to feel better about himself. Should he get Amanda back? Make his old friends like him again? Confront his estranged father? Eat a ton of Chinese food? Or maybe he should just finish his latest goddamned painting.

programme.title: Making Out

programme.title: Killer Drag Queens On Dope
programme.desc: Killer Drag Queens on Dope! is the wild story of Ginger & Coco, two dolls with a little secret... They're contract killers who work for a one-eyed lunatic named Uncle A. Half the cutthroats in town are trying to kill them, the other half are trying to sleep with them and Uncle A is just getting started. Ginger is hell on heels. Coco never met a drug she didn't like. Together, they're Killer Drag Queens on Dope!

programme.desc: Set on a tropical island in Thailand, the strange plight of a beleaguered chef who, while romancing a mysterious woman, discovers the diabolical Zen of cooking. Following a near death escape, he returns to Montreal and falls hard for the woman of his life who unfortunately craves only his cooking but not his loving. Worse still, strange things surfacing around him indicate that his journey to the Far East has deep, divine implications. The stage is set for him to take the 1st bite of true love and end the cycle of suffering for all involved.

programme.title: Girl Wired
programme.desc: A Preteen computer prodigy, Glory Vinci has invented an advance medical Ray Gun that can read peoples moods. She has been offered a scholarship to a prestigious Graduate Research Program but her guardian Grandfather is in gambling trouble with the mob, and when the nefarious gangsters discover that Gloria's device can read and steal anybody's credit card number they want to get their hands on it. They use Gloria's grandfathers debt to gain leverage on the family to make her give it to them but Gloria's just to smart for the mobsters and turns the tables on them. A hilarious family comedy.

programme.title: Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darin son puro fuego I Brujas de Zugarramurdi I Ministerio de brujas
programme.desc:
Bienvenidas al Ministerio de Brujas, donde cada martes a las 20h en Canal Barro, se enciende la hoguera y se queman verdades incómodas.
En este episodio, Carlos inauguró la nueva Subsecretaría de Misterios, trayendo algunas de las historias más oscuras y fascinantes de España: Las brujas de Zugarramurdi. La Inquisición y sus castigos. Y esos misterios que siguen latiendo entre cuevas, sombras y supersticiones.
Como siempre, en la hoguera ardieron muchas cosas: – Reglas imposibles. – Gente manipuladora que tensa la cuerda. – Vampiros energéticos y demás criaturas emocionales.
Pero el clímax llegó cuando las brujas leyeron las cartas astrales de Úrsula Corberó y Chino Darín en vivo. Él, con gen de líder pero alma aniñada y sexy. Ella, fuego puro, control y magnetismo. Juntos, una conexión casi kármica y familiar.
Además, se destacó en el Departamento de Archivos Clasificados a una nueva bruja ilustre: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, la voz que hechiza desde el feminismo y la palabra.
Y para cerrar con placer y picardía, en la Secretaría de Venus en Tanga, hubo tarot erótico: deseo, destino y mucha, mucha energía ardiente.
💜 Ministerio de Brujas: el único ministerio donde el fuego limpia, el deseo guía y la magia es ley. 📆 Todos los martes a las 20h (España) en @CanalBarro .

programme.title: Claudia Luchetti abre portales en vivo | La decodificadora más famosa en Ministerio de Brujas
programme.desc:
En este nuevo capítulo del Ministerio de Brujas, las ministras del zodiaco reciben a una invitada especial: Claudia Luchetti, la decodificadora más famosa de Argentina, una mujer que camina entre la neurociencia, la Kábbalah y la energía invisible. Coach, conferencista y bruja de luz, Claudia nos cuenta cómo llega a ser bruja, qué siente cuando baja información, y cuáles fueron los casos más paranormales que vivió acompañando a otros en su transformación.
Además, en esta edición: 🔥 El Protocolo de la Hoguera: lo que decidimos quemar —desde los machirulos hasta los taladros del vecino. 💋 Secretaría de Venus en Tanga: exploramos la energía erótica de Tauro, los placeres mundanos, los aromas, las texturas y los sentidos. 🎬 Cinematografía Zodiazal: nuevas películas bajo la lupa astrológica. 🌌 Boletín de Movimientos Planetarios: con ChongaZen desentrañando el clima cósmico. 📚 Archivos Clasificados de Brujas: hoy, la artista Tracey Emin, la mujer que transformó su cama en arte y su dolor en revolución.
Y como siempre, los Sindicatos Zodiacales elevan sus reclamos: ♒ Acuario: “Podridos de que nos digan fríos.” ♋ Cáncer: “¿Todo tenemos que sentir?” ♎ Libra: “¡Basta de falsedad!” ♑ Capricornio (sindicato de Claudia): “Queremos reconocimiento celestial por exceso de responsabilidad terrenal.”
El Ministerio de Brujas no explica. Encanta. Entre astros, carcajadas y conjuros, abrimos portales donde otros archivan silencios.
📅 Todos los martes 20:00 (España) / 15:00 (Argentina) 📺 En YouTube y Kick de @canalbarro

programme.desc:
Bienvenidas, bienvenidos y bienvenides al Ministerio de Brujas, el nuevo programa del Canal Barro donde la intuición, el arte y la magia se sientan a la misma mesa. Este primer episodio es un aquelarre de verdad: fuego, deseo, política, feminismo y mucho humor.
Las ministras @chongazen, @marianaenvozalta y @zakurapill abren las puertas del ministerio con un comunicado oficial:
“El Ministerio de Brujas no es un edificio ni un expediente. Es un estado de ánimo. Es ese rincón donde las brujas nos reunimos para decir lo que nadie dice, para reírnos de lo serio y darle seriedad a lo que parece una pavada.”
En este primer encuentro: - Protocolo de la Hoguera: adiós a los políticos, los alquileres imposibles, los machirulos, los vampiros energéticos y los hombres de Cáncer. Todo lo que sobra… se quema y se transmuta. - Secretaría de Venus en Tanga: astrología y erotismo sin censura. ¿Qué energía nos mueve en esta luna llena de Aries? - Boletín Oficial de Movimientos Planetarios: ChongaZen trae el parte astrológico del cielo y sus efectos terrenales. - Departamento de Estrellas y Sábanas: compatibilidades cósmicas. Hoy: Penélope Cruz y Javier Bardem. - Dirección de Cinematografía Zodiazal: la Dra. Fernanda Garrido recomienda películas según los elementos zodiacales. - Archivos Clasificados de Brujas: homenaje a Violeta Parra, la artista chilena que convirtió su dolor en himno y su rebeldía en legado eterno.
Aquí no hay jerarquías ni jefes: mandan las palabras, la energía y la conexión. Si entraste, ya eres parte del aquelarre.

programme.title: Hablemos claro de la menopausia con Celia Sancho en Matronas al Rescate.
programme.desc:
Bienvenida a Matronas al Rescate, el programa donde se habla claro, se ríe fuerte y se normaliza lo que nadie quiere nombrar. En este episodio, las matronas se enfrentan a un tema que llega antes de lo que crees: la menopausia y la perimenopausia. Para ello, invitan a Celia Sancho, una experta que viene a explicar (sin drama ni eufemismos) qué pasa realmente cuando el cuerpo cambia de guion.
👩‍⚕️ Gema está enfadada porque no consigue hacer un trámite digital. 🏫 Leo y Martina se quedan a dormir en el cole. 😬 Un paciente chungo, una amiga que no levanta cabeza y un cumpleaños infantil con más puntos en la vagina de la madre que en la tarta. Y entre todo esto: el Día Mundial de la Salud Mental, el parto en casa de Verdeliss, el ADN de tus ex que sigue dentro de ti (microquimerismo) y las cesáreas privadas que duplican lo que recomienda la OMS.
Con Celia hablamos de síntomas, soluciones, sexualidad y autoconocimiento, porque no es el fin de nada: es una nueva versión de ti.
💬 Conclusión: no es “la edad”, es una nueva temporada hormonal. Y aquí están las matronas para acompañarte con humor, ciencia y cero filtros.
📅 Nuevo episodio cada Jueves a las 11h en el canal de YouTube de @CanalBarro Presentan: las Matronas al Rescate.

programme.title: ¿Las pantallas están criando a tus hijos? Sol Macaluso y Fátima de Francisco en Matronas al Rescate
programme.desc:
uevo programa de Matronas al Rescate en Canal Barro — y esta vez tocamos uno de los temas más urgentes: cómo las pantallas, las redes sociales y la inteligencia artificial están afectando a la infancia.
Las invitadas de lujo fueron: 💬 Sol Macaluso, periodista e influencer, que compartió su experiencia personal de crianza en tiempos digitales. 📚 Fátima de Francisco, especialista en educación y crianza, que nos habló de los riesgos y efectos reales del uso de pantallas y recomendó libros imprescindibles para madres y padres.
Además: 🍼 Desmontamos trucos virales para dormir bebés, 🧠 debatimos sobre educación sexual y responsabilidad digital, 😱 y Fátima nos dejó helados con un dato impactante: el vídeo pornográfico más descargado de 2017 fue el de “La Manada”, una muestra brutal de la falta de educación sexual y empatía social que seguimos arrastrando.
Un programa necesario, incómodo, pero urgente. 👉 Matronas al Rescate, todos los jueves a las 11:00 AM (España) en YouTube Canal Barro.

programme.title: Matronas: prematuros, alimentos y un 1,2,3 divertido para explicar los básicos de nutrición
programme.desc:
Nuevo jueves en Matronas al Rescate (todos los jueves a las 11:00h en @CanalBarro y venimos cargadas de temas que importan, que ayudan y que, sí, también hacen reír.
En este episodio hablamos de:
✨ Día Mundial del Prematuro — Atención especializada, UCIN, apoyo emocional y derechos que aún faltan. — La revolución del útero artificial. — Cómo afectan los disruptores endocrinos.
🍼 Alimentación Complementaria (AC) con Arantxa — Señales reales de que un bebé está listo. — BLW vs cuchara: corte seguro, práctica en directo y cero dramas. — Plato Harvard, cantidades reales y alimentos estrella. — Alimentos NO recomendados antes del año y por qué. — Juegos, fallos, explicaciones y risas.
🥄 Sueño, hierro, alergias y alimentos clave — Qué favorece el sueño. — Cómo sumar hierro de forma eficaz. — El mapa de alérgenos sin miedo. — Pescados con mercurio: los que sí, los que no. — Todos los nombres del azúcar (sí, TODOS).
🚨 Seguridad y primeros auxilios — Arcada vs atragantamiento: cómo diferenciarlo de verdad. — Técnica básica que toda madre debería saber.
😅 Destete Respetuoso — Qué es, cómo se hace y cómo evitar convertirlo en tragedia griega. — Destete nocturno, diario de tomas y herramientas prácticas.
💜 Además: Cumple de Alejandro, fin de semana de caca(s), cocido de mamá, citologías, sección joven con manualidades… y la liada de Ana Brito con la lactancia prolongada.
Si eres madre, padre, tía, tío, futura familia o simplemente te obsesiona entender cómo sobreviven los bebés… este episodio te va a salvar media vida.
En este episodio de Matronas nos pusimos en modo clásico total: jugamos al mítico “1,2,3… responda otra vez” para explicar los alimentos clave del embarazo sin que nadie cabecee del aburrimiento. Un repaso nutricional hecho juego, con ritmo de concurso vintage y momentos gloriosos que solo pueden ocurrir cuando mezclas conocimiento, velocidad mental y mucha chispa.
Además, las matronas bajaron a tierra mitos, explicaron qué comer, qué evitar y por qué, mientras el equipo competía como si hubiera bote final. Es divulgación, sí… pero disfrazada de tele de culto.
El próximo episodio promete más ciencia, más humor y alguna que otra sorpresa que hará que estudiar embarazo sea más adictivo que un viernes de gala.

programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, Howard and Rachel G. showcase various cigar humidification and travel accessories, including a high-capacity cigar cabinet with internal lighting and a miniature "golf bag" travel humidor. They also demonstrate practical maintenance tools such as cigar scissors for controlled cutting and a waterproof, drop-resistant single-flame torch lighter designed for outdoor use.

programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, hosts Howard G. and Rachel G. unbox and review five cigar accessories. They demonstrate a variety of tools, including a cedar-lined travel case kit , a digital humidometer , a rose-gold torch with an integrated cutter , and a set of protective mouthpieces. The show concludes with a heavy cast-iron monkey ashtray that vents smoke through its nostrils, with the hosts highlighting the unexpected affordability of all the products.

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: Sean visits Captain's Cigar Lounge in downtown Clearwater, Florida, and speaks with General Manager Glenn. programme.title: Cigar Essentials
programme.desc: In this episode of Cigar Essentials, hosts Howard and Rachel G. showcase a variety of cigar accessories, including a high-quality acrylic humidor, a cedar-lined leather travel case, and lead-free crystal pairing glasses.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Law Ream Zino Cigars
programme.desc: Sean lights up a conversation with Law Ream of Zino Cigars. Beyond his celebrated reviews, Law shares his journey into the world of cigar criticism, his unique methodology for dissecting a blend, and what he believes truly makes a cigar worthy of his praise.

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: This episode explores Gurkha cigars' collaborative "Year of the Dragon 2024" series, featuring partnerships with master blenders and showcasing the brand's innovative packaging, promotional strategies, and dedication to the broader cigar community.

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.sub-title: Burn Rate - Drew Estate Undercrown 10 Toro
programme.desc: On this episode of Burn Rate, hosts Bryan Baiss and Chris Kelly review the Undercrown 10 by Drew Estate Toro, evaluating its craftsmanship and flavor profile which featured dry cherry and black pepper, noting a consistently burning cigar despite its initial dryness.

programme.title: Cigar City Unrolled
programme.desc: On this episode of Unrolled, we take a look at The Cigar Castle! General Manager Rick is here to show us this unique lounge with a wide variety of selection and an impressive humidor!

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Lynn Hawkins Plasencia Cigars
programme.desc: Sean sits down with Lynn Hawkins of Placencia Cigars, one of the most respected names in the industry. Lynn pulls back the curtain on Placencia's extensive history as a leading grower and producer, sharing insights into their meticulous tobacco cultivation, the intricate art of their cigar manufacturing process, and what makes their family's legacy truly stand out in the world of premium cigars.

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: In this episode of Unrolled, Sean Mobley visits Stogie Pairing Cigar Lounge in Fort Myers, Florida, where owners Joey and Jessica showcase their establishment, boasting 28 beer taps, 75 types of bottled and canned beers, and a full wine selection, emphasizing their commitment to diverse pairings for cigars.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Rick Rodriguez West Tampa Tobacco Co
programme.desc: In this episode of "Behind the Blend," Sean Mobley interviews Rick Rodriguez, also known as "Chef Rick," from West Tampa Tobacco, who explains his nickname comes from blending tobacco like a chef uses food to create a desired flavor profile. Rick introduces new cigars like the "Circle of Life," a tribute to his mentors, and the "Double Crab," part of a Tampa-inspired trilogy, shaped like a "flying pig". He shares his personal journey into the cigar industry at age 40 and emphasizes that for him, cigars represent "connection" and a "gateway for a new friendship".

programme.title: Unrolled
programme.desc: In this episode of Unrolled, Sean Mobley visits Stogie Pairing Cigar Lounge in Fort Myers, Florida, where owners Joey and Jessica showcase their establishment, boasting 28 beer taps, 75 types of bottled and canned beers, and a full wine selection, emphasizing their commitment to diverse pairings for cigars.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Steven Bartell Molon Labe
programme.desc: Join host Sean Mobley as he sits down with Steven Bartell, the visionary owner and founder of Molon Labe. Discover the story behind the only company in the world that combines rare reserve cigars, whiskey, and coffee all under one roof.

programme.title: Burn Rate
programme.sub-title: Burn Rate - Southern Draw Rose Of Sharon Dozen Roses Solomon
programme.desc: In this episode of "Burn Rate," hosts Bryan and Chris Kelly review the Southern Draw Rose of Sharon, Dozen Roses, a Casa de Montecristo exclusive in a Salomon vitola. They praise its craftsmanship, noting the oily, thin-veined Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper and consistent burn.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Brian Motola And George Hadweh Cavalier
programme.desc: In this episode of "Behind the Blend," Sean Mobley interviews Brian and George from Cavalier Cigars, who discuss their roles within the company, with Brian as a partner in the Honduran factory (FBT) and George as the sales representative for Florida and Puerto Rico. Brian shares his recent full-time move to Honduras, highlighting the country's beauty and the factory's unique practice of hand-applying gold leaf to cigars, a process where empowered employees can reject imperfect products.

programme.title: Behind The Blend
programme.sub-title: Behind The Blend - Desiree Sylver Drunk Chicken
programme.desc: Established in 2019, Drunk Chicken Cigars (DC Cigars) are handmade in the U.S.A. to create premium flavor profiles. Every combination of tobacco leaf, including the filler, binder, and wrapper, was chosen to produce an assortment of smooth, rich, and savory cigars with a variety of customers in mind. Join Sean has he dicusses the mission of the DC Cigars family is to produce premium cigars that can be smoked anytime of the day.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his "magical" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Qingdao: The Jade Island
programme.desc: To boost Qingdao’s international‑oriented publicity and build its profile as an international tourist city, this episode takes us to Qingdao. Through three segments‑‑Modern Qingdao, Historic Qingdao and Internationalized Qingdao, we showcase the diverse facets of this charming city.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.3
programme.desc: Join Tianran He on a high-speed train to Shigatse, gateway to the Himalayas and home to Mount Qomolangma, the world’s highest peak. As the city with the most land ports in Xizang, Shigatse serves as a key corridor to South Asia. Here, Tianran samples breakfast at a bustling local teahouse and experiences monastic life at the vast Tashilunpo Monastery. He then visits an agricultural park where tropical crops thrive against the odds of the alpine plateau, before discovering pulu — a traditional Tibetan textile now earning global acclaim.

programme.title: Shenzhen：When Travel meets Technology
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Shenzhen series, we adopt high-tech aerial shooting and follow the host on a city tour, letting audiences experience Shenzhen’s vigorous development, lush ecological scenery and cutting-edge technological strength.
